purpose: Source template for the fail-closed GerChain/EAI production master gate. Run-specific SHA, evidence, and decision data must be emitted into a retained workflow artifact, never baked into this tracked template.
sha_binding_rule: The workflow must bind the decision artifact to SOURCE_SHA and checked-out HEAD. A mismatch blocks the gate. This source template intentionally contains no candidate SHA.

architecture_criteria.required_evidence: Exact-SHA runtime, store, writer/reader, entrypoint, and adapter inventory.
Duplicate-authority and failure-mode register with closure evidence.
PostgreSQL deep reconciliation report with no unexplained mismatches.
Evidence that canonical Ledger, Escrow, Witness, and Outbox are authoritative.
Lifecycle, conservation, idempotency, replay, rollback, and transaction-boundary tests.
Exact-SHA tests for every declared cross-layer adapter boundary.
G3 policy, authorization/release separation, and fail-closed negative tests.
Real PostgreSQL atomicity, concurrency, rollback, and single-movement proof.
External IAM/MFA, privileged-access review, least-privilege, and revocation evidence.
Readiness/liveness, logs, metrics, alert, and recovery verification.
Repeatable production-like load/concurrency report with defined thresholds.
Backup/restore drill with RPO/RTO and post-restore integrity reconciliation.
Exact-SHA required checks, protected branch, approval, artifact provenance, and rollback evidence.
Independent operator reproduces critical tests from a clean environment and records exact SHA/results.
Complete integrity-checked evidence index tied to one immutable candidate SHA.

postgres_checks.required_evidence: Compileall result from the exact candidate SHA.
In-scope EAI/CORE JUnit report with zero failures and errors.
Real PostgreSQL 16 connection and production entrypoint boot proof.
Failed migration leaves no partial schema or history publication.
Supported legacy schema upgrade preserves canonical data and constraints.
Canonical lifecycle JUnit and PostgreSQL value-flow evidence.
Concurrent runners serialize and publish each migration exactly once.
Migration registry and applied history contain no duplicate/conflicting publication.
Production entrypoint/factory starts on PostgreSQL and rejects unsafe fallbacks.
Contiguous migration versions and file/database checksum match.
Deep value-truth reconciliation JUnit/report from PostgreSQL.
Evidence manifest and detached checksums verify, including exact SHA and complete source hashes.
